scope: Ordinary unit0 parentless anonymous classes mixed with plain empty named declarations in bracketed namespaces. Source-authenticated namespace body and root-block ancestry retain early binding/cost0; conditional declarations cost1 even when not executed. Qualified names separate namespace-local internal-looking and same-short-name classes; ABSENT global namespace and shared cross-namespace RTD counters are included. Wider contexts remain required.

<?php
namespace NamedRoot {
    $early = new Early;
    { { class Early {} } }
    $firstLine = __LINE__ + 1;
    $first = new class {
        public $value = 0;
        public function scope() { return self::class; }
    };
    class After {}
    $secondLine = __LINE__ + 1;
    $second = new class {};
    $firstName = 'class@anonymous' . "\0" . __FILE__ . ':' . $firstLine . '$0';
    $secondName = 'class@anonymous' . "\0" . __FILE__ . ':' . $secondLine . '$1';
    echo $early::class === 'NamedRoot\Early' ? 'early|' : 'BAD|';
    echo $first::class === $firstName && $first->scope() === $firstName ? 'first|' : 'BAD|';
    echo $second::class === $secondName ? 'second|' : 'BAD|';
    $again = new $firstName;
    $again->value = 9;
    echo $again !== $first && $again::class === $firstName ? 'fresh|' : 'BAD|';
    echo $first->value, ':', $again->value, '|';
    $after = new After;
    echo $after::class === 'NamedRoot\After' ? 'named' : 'BAD';
}
